question: Your support agent must call get_customer as its very first action in every conversation, before it uses lookup_order or process_refund. In testing, the agent sometimes calls lookup_order first, and sometimes it replies with a clarifying question in plain text. Which tool_choice configuration best guarantees the required first step while letting the agent continue the workflow afterward?

options.text: Set tool_choice to {"type": "tool", "name": "get_customer"} on every turn of the conversation, including follow-up turns.
options.reason: Forcing the same tool on every turn stops the agent from calling lookup_order or process_refund, while the guide forces only the first call and handles later steps in follow-up turns.

options.text: Set tool_choice to "auto" on the first turn and add a system prompt instruction to call get_customer first.
options.reason: "auto" lets the model return text or pick any tool, so a prompt instruction gives no guarantee that get_customer is called first.

options.text: Set tool_choice to "any" on the first turn so that the model must call a tool instead of replying with text.
options.reason: "any" guarantees that the model calls some tool rather than returning text, but the model still chooses which tool, so it could call lookup_order first.

options.text: Set tool_choice to {"type": "tool", "name": "get_customer"} on the first turn, then handle the later steps in follow-up turns.
options.reason: Forced tool selection ensures that this specific tool is called first, and the guide pairs it with processing subsequent steps in follow-up turns.
